lead_raw_text:
The structure of CeMnAu crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁/a (No. 143), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms—four Ce, four Mn, and four Au—distributed across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies 12-coordinate close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ce and Au each have 12 geometric neighbors (6 Au/Ce and 6 Mn), while Mn has 12 neighbors (4 Au and 8 Ce). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Au and Ce 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner and edge sharing between Au polyhedra.
